title: チューリップ賞の後に・先制勝利！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka beats Daiwa Scarlet. They both feel each other's growth, vowing to race against each other again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, in order to continue racing Daiwa Scarlet in the Tiara tour, Vodka would have to give up on the Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she follows through with Scarlet, it would be near unprecedented to switch back to the Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To confront her rival or chase her dream… Not wanting to give up on either, Vodka puts off her decision and runs in the Oka Sho.
